basics.description: **Note:** Please refer to the following before installing the solution: • Review the solution [Release Notes](https://github.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/tree/master/Solutions/Claroty%20xDome%20CCF/ReleaseNotes.md) • There may be [known issues](https://aka.ms/sentinelsolutionsknownissues) pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing. The Claroty xDome CCF solution ingests Claroty xDome data into Microsoft Sentinel using the Codeless Connector Framework (CCF) pull pattern - polling the xDome public API directly, with no agent, collector VM, or syslog forwarder required. A single API-polling data connector ingests seven data types into dedicated tables: Alerts, Device-Alert relations, OT Activity Events, Vulnerabilities, Device-Vulnerability relations, Device inventory, and Audit Log. Each data type supports an optional filter to control ingested volume. Connect once with your xDome API root URL and a Bearer API token. **Data Connectors:** 1, **Parsers:** 10, **Analytic Rules:** 2, **Hunting Queries:** 3 [Learn more about Microsoft Sentinel](https://aka.ms/azuresentinel) | [Learn more about Solutions](https://aka.ms/azuresentinelsolutionsdoc)

options.text: This Solution installs the data connector for Claroty xDome (via Codeless Connector Framework). You can get Claroty xDome (via Codeless Connector Framework) data in your Microsoft Sentinel workspace. After installing the solution, configure and enable this data connector by following guidance in Manage solution view.

options.text: This solution installs a workbook for Claroty xDome. After installing the solution, the workbook can be managed from the Manage solution view.
This solution installs analytic rule templates for Claroty xDome. After installing the solution, create and enable analytic rules from the Manage solution view.

elements.name: analytic1
elements.label: Claroty xDome - Known-exploited vulnerability on an OT device

options.text:
Identifies devices categorized as OT that are affected by a vulnerability flagged as known-exploited
(CISA KEV) by Claroty xDome. Known-exploited vulnerabilities on operational technology assets represent
a high-priority remediation and monitoring target.

elements.name: analytic2
elements.label: Claroty xDome - High or critical severity threat alert on a device

options.text:
Surfaces Claroty xDome device alerts normalized to the ASIM Alert Event schema whose severity is
High or Critical. These alerts typically indicate threat activity, malicious communication, or
policy violations affecting an OT/IoT/IT device and warrant investigation.
This solution installs hunting queries for Claroty xDome. After installing the solution, run these hunting queries to hunt for threats from the Manage solution view.

Lists OT and IoT devices that Claroty xDome reports as communicating with the internet. Operational
technology and IoT assets should rarely talk directly to the internet; those that do are candidate
pivot points for command-and-control or data exfiltration and should be reviewed. This hunting query depends on ClarotyXDomeCCFConnector data connector (ClarotyXDomeDevice_CL Parser or Table)

elements.name: huntingquery2
elements.label: Claroty xDome - Devices using insecure protocols

options.text:
Surfaces devices that Claroty xDome reports as using insecure or clear-text protocols (for example
Telnet, FTP, or unauthenticated industrial protocols). These weaken the environment and can enable
credential capture or lateral movement, especially on OT segments. This hunting query depends on ClarotyXDomeCCFConnector data connector (ClarotyXDomeDevice_CL Parser or Table)

elements.name: huntingquery3
elements.label: Claroty xDome - OT configuration or mode changes

options.text:
Highlights Claroty xDome OT activity events that represent configuration uploads/downloads, firmware
or program transfers, or controller mode changes, normalized to the ASIM Network Session schema.
These engineering operations against industrial controllers can be legitimate maintenance or an
indicator of tampering, and are worth reviewing against a change window. This hunting query depends on ClarotyXDomeCCFConnector data connector (ClarotyXDomeOTEvent_CL Parser or Table)
